answer_1.quote: In this paper, we tackle the problem of generating CS text from monolingual text while providing inference-time levers to control for CMI, SPI and formality of the generated CS text.

answer_2.quote: Semantic consistency with the source monolingual sentence is computed using BLEU scores between a reference CS sentence and the generated sentence.

answer_4.quote: We created a template that asks linguistic experts to assess model outputs on naturalness, semantic consistency and formality. Every CS sentence was evaluated along each of these dimensions by 3 human raters.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were shown a monolingual Hindi sentence, its machine-generated code-switched counterpart, and asked How natural does the mixed language sentence sound? ... How well does the mixed-language sentence capture the meaning of the Hindi sentence? ... Which among the code-switched sentences is more formal?
